description: OpenTelemetry dashboard providing HTTP request/response cumulative metrics.

options.content:
### Azure Monitor Application Insights with OpenTelemetry Metrics (HTTP)

This dashboard requires OpenTelemetry metrics to be ingested into an Application Insights resource with OTLP enabled.
For onboarding instructions, see [App Insights with OTel](https://aka.ms/AppInsightswithOTel)

*Note: This dashboard should only be used for metrics which are ingested in cumulative temporality. This is **not** the default setting for the Application Insights OpenTelemetry distro and should only be used if you know your metrics are exported in cumulative temporality. [Learn More](https://aka.ms/OtelMetricTemp)*

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by ("$service_label", le) (rate({"http.server.duration", "$service_label"=~"$service_name"}[$__rate_interval])))) / 1000 or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by ("$service_label", le) (rate({"http.server.request.duration", "$service_label"=~"$service_name"}[$__rate_interval])))

(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by ("$service_label", "http.route", le) (rate({"http.server.duration", "$service_label"=~"$service_name"}[$__rate_interval])))) / 1000 or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by ("$service_label", "http.route", le) (rate({"http.server.request.duration", "$service_label"=~"$service_name"}[$__rate_interval])))

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by ("$service_label", le) (rate({"http.client.duration", "$service_label"=~"$service_name"}[$__rate_interval])))) / 1000 or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by ("$service_label", le) (rate({"http.client.request.duration", "$service_label"=~"$service_name"}[$__rate_interval])))

(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by ("$service_label","http.route", le) (rate({"http.client.duration", "$service_label"=~"$service_name"}[$__rate_interval])))) / 1000 or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by ("$service_label","http.route", le) (rate({"http.client.request.duration", "$service_label"=~"$service_name"}[$__rate_interval])))
